```{=html}
<div id="cv-viewer" class="cv-viewer" aria-live="polite">
  <div class="cv-status" id="cv-status"><i class="bi bi-hourglass-split"></i> Loading CV…</div>
</div>
<noscript><p>Your browser has JavaScript turned off. <a href="files/cv.pdf">Open the CV as a PDF</a>.</p></noscript>

<!-- PDF.js renders the PDF as page images inside this page, so it looks the
     same in every browser and never hands off to a PDF plug-in or download. -->
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdf.js/3.11.174/pdf.min.js"></script>
<script>
(function () {
  var PDF_URL = "files/cv.pdf";
  var host = document.getElementById("cv-viewer");
  var status = document.getElementById("cv-status");
  var pdfDoc = null, lastWidth = 0, renderToken = 0;

  function fail() {
    status.innerHTML = 'The CV could not be displayed here. <a href="' + PDF_URL + '">Open the PDF instead</a>.';
  }
  if (!window.pdfjsLib) { fail(); return; }
  pdfjsLib.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdf.js/3.11.174/pdf.worker.min.js";

  function renderAll() {
    var width = host.clientWidth;
    if (!pdfDoc || !width || Math.abs(width - lastWidth) < 2) return;
    lastWidth = width;
    var token = ++renderToken;
    var dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2.5);
    var frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
    var jobs = [];
    for (var n = 1; n <= pdfDoc.numPages; n++) {
      jobs.push(pdfDoc.getPage(n).then(function (page) {
        var base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
        var scale = width / base.width;
        var vp = page.getViewport({ scale: scale });
        var sheet = document.createElement("div");
        sheet.className = "cv-page";
        sheet.style.aspectRatio = base.width + " / " + base.height;
        var canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
        canvas.width = Math.floor(vp.width * dpr);
        canvas.height = Math.floor(vp.height * dpr);
        canvas.setAttribute("aria-label", "CV page " + page.pageNumber);
        canvas.setAttribute("role", "img");
        sheet.appendChild(canvas);
        // Keep the CV's own links (email, GitHub, DOIs) clickable
        page.getAnnotations().then(function (annots) {
          annots.forEach(function (a) {
            if (a.subtype !== "Link" || !a.url) return;
            var r = vp.convertToViewportRectangle(a.rect);
            var link = document.createElement("a");
            link.href = a.url;
            link.className = "cv-link";
            link.target = "_blank";
            link.rel = "noopener";
            link.style.left = (Math.min(r[0], r[2]) / vp.width * 100) + "%";
            link.style.top = (Math.min(r[1], r[3]) / vp.height * 100) + "%";
            link.style.width = (Math.abs(r[2] - r[0]) / vp.width * 100) + "%";
            link.style.height = (Math.abs(r[3] - r[1]) / vp.height * 100) + "%";
            link.setAttribute("aria-label", a.url);
            sheet.appendChild(link);
          });
        });
        return page.render({
          canvasContext: canvas.getContext("2d"),
          viewport: vp,
          transform: dpr !== 1 ? [dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0] : null
        }).promise.then(function () { return sheet; });
      }));
    }
    Promise.all(jobs).then(function (sheets) {
      if (token !== renderToken) return;
      sheets.forEach(function (s) { frag.appendChild(s); });
      host.replaceChildren(frag);
    }).catch(fail);
  }

  pdfjsLib.getDocument(PDF_URL).promise.then(function (doc) {
    pdfDoc = doc;
    renderAll();
    var t;
    window.addEventListener("resize", function () { clearTimeout(t); t = setTimeout(renderAll, 200); });
  }).catch(fail);
})();
</script>
```
